title: Design contest

words.note: 和 design contest 最直接、最中性的近義表達。可用於平面設計、產品設計、建築設計、時裝、UX 等。

exercises.original: The school is holding a design contest for a new logo.

options.explanation: — design competition 是本題最貼切的改寫；它保留 design contest 的競賽／創意提交核心，並符合 Design competition 的特定活動形式。
— creative challenge = 創意挑戰，偏解題與創新，競賽意味可較弱。

— hackathon = 短時間團隊創新／技術活動，是特定活動形式。
— exhibition = 展覽，展示作品但不一定評獎。

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎項不等於比賽本身 design award 可以指獎項／獎項制度；contest 是參賽和評選過程。
falseSynonyms.point: The competition selects the winner; the award is what the winner receives.

falseSynonyms.zh: 招標不等於一般設計比賽 tender 通常與採購、合約、價格和正式投標程序有關。
falseSynonyms.point: A tender selects a supplier, while a design competition primarily evaluates design proposals.

falseSynonyms.zh: 黑客松是特定活動形式 hackathon 通常是短時間團隊開發／創新活動，常涉及科技原型，不等於所有 design contests。
falseSynonyms.point: A hackathon may include design, but its format is broader and more intensive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 展覽不等於競賽 exhibition 展示作品；可以沒有排名、評審或獎項。
falseSynonyms.point: The exhibition displayed the entries after the competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 作品集評審不等於設計競賽 portfolio review 是評閱個人作品集，常用於招生、招聘或專業反饋。
falseSynonyms.point: A portfolio review evaluates a body of work, not a single contest brief.

falseSynonyms.zh: 委約不等於比賽 commission 是直接委託某人完成設計，可完全沒有公開競賽。
falseSynonyms.point: The artist received a commission without entering a competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工作坊重點是學習／共創 design workshop 可以產生方案，但通常不是以排名或獎項為核心。
falseSynonyms.point: The workshop generated ideas; the competition selected a winner.

falseSynonyms.zh: 徵集提案未必是競賽 call for proposals 可能只是收集／評估方案，未必有公開排名或獎項。
falseSynonyms.point: A call for proposals can lead to selection without being framed as a contest.
